questions.question:
Six letters, L, M, N, O, P and Q are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the letter on the face opposite M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0523de769991a2f0497eac7ee3bb63b4bb97040c3b36d7a5d2c52c8d6e44ff77.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'M', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e760b31e4d89d92f2fc32047c135dfaf9976aa10513800315d1cdedd34440b08.png] 

From both dices, Q and N are common. So, remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

So, P will be opposite to M.

Hence, the correct answer is "P".

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given e×pression.

23 * 9 * 13 * 96 * 2 * 92
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f11fbb4e091305a6b414e74c3aec25b8d519670a1f3bd65f5bd4eb1bdcd68.png] 

Given equation: 23 * 9 * 13 * 96 * 2 * 92

Option 1) ×, +, –, ÷, =

Mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs:

⇒ 23 × 9 + 13 - __**96 ÷ 2**__ = 92

⇒ __**23 **____**×**____** 9**__ + 13 - 48 = 92

⇒ __**207**____** + 13**__ - 48 = 92

⇒ __**200**____** - 48**__<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);"
